annotations.title: Skilled nursing benchmarks for a state

description: Medicare cost-report benchmarks for skilled nursing facilities in one state (or the US, or a national ownership or size group): 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile occupancy, net patient revenue and operating expense per patient day, reported operating margin, Medicare/Medicaid/other share of days, Medicare PPS payment per Medicare day, contract labor share and beds, with the US median, the prior-year medians and the report count.

national_group.description: Optional, with state US only: a national ownership (type of control) or bed-size group instead of all facilities.

state.description: Two-letter state code or state name, e.g. TX or Texas. "US" (the default) for the national figures.

name: state_benchmarks
title: Skilled nursing benchmarks for a state
